name: Fire Inside the Building (Example)
summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. A sample workflow for demonstrating work centers and schedules — not a real fire procedure.

checklist.title: Before you start
checklist.intro: Example workflow only. It is here to show branching, parallel tracks and scheduling. It is not a fire procedure and must not be used in a real emergency.
items: Fire alarm panel and its reset key
Site address and nearest cross street, written down
Assembly point list and staff roster

question.prompt: What do the cameras and the panel show?
question.help: This only changes whether anyone goes near the fire. Everything else happens either way.
question.label: Situation

steps.title: Confirm the alarm
steps.body: Check the panel for the zone, then pull up the cameras covering it. Note the zone and floor before you do anything else.

steps.title: Small and contained
steps.body: A trained staff member may use the nearest extinguisher, with a clear way out behind them. Nobody goes in alone.

steps.title: Spreading — nobody approaches
steps.body: No one attempts to fight it. Keep people away from the zone and leave it to the fire service.

steps.title: Cannot tell — treat it as spreading
steps.body: If the cameras are smoked out or the zone is out of view, assume the worst. Nobody approaches.

steps.title: Sound the building alarm
steps.body: Set the alarm to full evacuate. Do not silence it, even if the panel lets you.

steps.title: Release the doors
steps.body: Drop access control on the escape routes so no door holds anyone up.

steps.title: Call emergency services
steps.body: Give the address, the cross street, the zone and floor, and whether anyone is unaccounted for.

steps.title: Stay on the line
steps.body: Do not hang up first. Dispatch will ask for the gate code and the best approach.

steps.title: Announce the evacuation
steps.body: Make the PA announcement: which zone, which exits to use, and the assembly point.

steps.title: Send the floor wardens
steps.body: Call the wardens on the radio and send them to sweep their own floors on the way out.

steps.title: Take the roll call
steps.body: Collect warden reports at the assembly point and mark the roster. Flag anyone not accounted for.

steps.title: Meet the fire service
steps.body: Hand over the panel zone, the roster, and the names of anyone missing. They take command from here.

steps.title: Log it and stand by
steps.body: Record times, zone and who was notified. Nobody re-enters until the fire service gives the all-clear.
